channel.title: The Edge 105 FM - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Edge 105 FM (edge105.com)

item.title: UK-based singer Morgan pays tribute to Sister Nancy’s Bam Bam with Bum Bum - The Edge FM
item.description: Morgan recently released the song Bum Bum, a tribute to old-school deejay Sister Nancy’s iconic and often-sampled hit Bam Bam.

item.title: Algorithm and blues — Looming AI threat and its possible impact on Jamaican music - The Edge FM
item.description: Michael Smith, a musician himself, was charged with three crimes with law enforcement officials labelling the case the first of its kind involving artificially inflated music streaming.

item.title: UTech, Jamaica to confer honorary degrees on nation-builders at 2024 graduation ceremony - The Edge FM
item.description: In recognition of his phenomenal achievements in music and for his contribution to nation-building, he will be conferred with the Doctor of Letters Honoris Causa on Friday, November 15, 2024.

item.title: Reggae, dancehall stars support Garvey One Destiny Concert - The Edge FM
item.description: The biggest reggae and dancehall artistes will perform live at the Garvey One Destiny Concert on Sunday, October 20, at the National Arena.

item.title: Tessanne Chin set to release third studio album - The Edge FM
item.description: Singer Tessanne Chin says she is working on a new album, the follow-up to 2014’s Count on My Love.

item.title: From school singer to sound clash legend: Billy Slaughter marks 33 years with Stone Love, celebrates GSOG Belt - The Edge FM
item.description: Celebrating 33 years with the iconic Stone Love sound system, Esran “Billy Slaughter” Phillips has not only carved a place for himself in Jamaica’s dancehall scene but has also become a global ambassador for sound system culture.

item.title: Brotha George ‘thankful’ over Grammy consideration - The Edge FM
item.description: For the second straight year, gospel artiste Brotha George has an album earmarked for a Grammy Award. His Mindset is among 75 albums up for consideration in the Best Reggae Album category.

item.title: Junelle Bromfield and Noah Lyles get engaged - The Edge FM
item.description: Lyles made the announcement via a video shared across his social media platforms. The video shared to his Instagram was captioned, “To my future wife, I will love you forever”.

item.title: Another certification for Omi, as ‘Hula Hoop’ is certified silver in the UK - The Edge FM
item.description: Hula Hoop, the second single issued from Omi’s gold-selling debut album Me 4 U, has reached a new milestone.

item.title: Shenseea continues rise with Work Me Out - The Edge FM
item.description: Work Me Out is featured on Shenseea’s sophomore album Never Gets Late Here. The song inches up from #41 to #40 in its 4th week on Billboard’s R&B/Hip-Hop Airplay chart.
